honest_findings: Moondream correctly detects high-level topological lines, junctions, and generic graphical structures.
Moondream struggles with fine-grained alphanumeric P&ID tags (e.g., small instrument tag labels) due to tokenization and 378x378/image resolution limits.

Specialized engineering symbols (e.g. distinct check valve vs globe valve glyphs) are often described as generic geometric shapes (e.g. triangles or circles) rather than precise ISA-5.1 standard symbols.
Tripartite grounding in Llama3 is essential to prevent hallucination by forcing separation between visual evidence and engineering inferences.

questions_detail.question: What alphanumeric equipment tags or component numbers are visible in this P&ID diagram?
questions_detail.expected_domain_nature: Specific equipment identifiers like V-101, P-101, or numeric stream tags

questions_detail.question: Can you identify any pump symbols in this diagram? Where are they located?
questions_detail.expected_domain_nature: Centrifugal pump or positive displacement pump circular/impeller symbol

questions_detail.question: Identify any valves (e.g. gate, globe, check, or control valves) visible along the process lines.
questions_detail.expected_domain_nature: Two opposing triangles symbol representing an in-line valve

questions_detail.question: Determine whether the major process lines connect the components together or if they are separate circuits.
questions_detail.expected_domain_nature: Interconnected process piping lines with junctions/branches

questions_detail.question: Are there flow direction arrows indicating the direction of fluid transport on the piping lines?
